item.title: Coarsening of Bisection Meshes
item.description: Coarsening a mesh produced by Newest Vertex Bisection (NVB) undoes bisections.

item.title: Newest Vertex Bisection
item.description: Newest vertex bisection (NVB) refines triangular meshes without creating Hanging Nodes.

item.title: Pixel Images and Finite Element Functions
item.description: Learned priors, image denoisers and plots work with pixel images, while the forward problem works with finite element coefficients.

item.title: ModularEIT Wiki
item.description: A wiki on the theory of Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT): the physics and mathematics of the forward and inverse problem, finite element discretisation, adjoint-based gradients, optimisation, and classical and learned regularisation.

item.title: Grounding of the Potential
item.description: The solution of the Neumann Problem is unique only up to an additive constant: if u solves it, so does u+c. Only potential differences are physical.

item.title: A Posteriori Error Estimation and Adaptive Meshing
item.description: A finite element solution u_h satisfies the discrete equations exactly.

item.title: Adaptive Meshing in EIT
item.description: Adaptive mesh refinement repeats SOLVE → ESTIMATE → MARK → REFINE (see A Posteriori Error Estimation and Adaptive Meshing).

item.title: Residual Estimator for the Conductivity Equation
item.description: The residual-based estimator of A Posteriori Error Estimation and Adaptive Meshing, written out for the discretised Conductivity Equation with the boundary conditions of the Electrode Models.

item.title: Dörfler Marking
item.description: Dörfler (bulk) marking decides which cells to refine from the local error indicators \eta_K.

item.title: Goal-Oriented Error Estimation
item.description: Energy-norm estimators control the error everywhere in \Omega. EIT, however, only uses a few numbers: the electrode voltages.
